heads.name: half_sample_and_mean_rate_bounds
heads.purpose: Shared deterministic m-to-n and mean-shift scales
heads.inputProvenance: p/hp/J/hJ from frozen276; actual Kmean nonnegative derived from its fixed expression; n/m original half-sample relation
heads.outputUse: PUBLIC275 and273 errors and original delta, with broad factors2
heads.headText:
private theorem half_sample_and_mean_rate_bounds
    (p J Kmean : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p ∧ p ≤ 3)
    (hJ : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ J) (hKmean : 0 ≤ Kmean)
    (n m : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnm : n ≤ 2 * m) :
    let a : ℝ := (p - 2) / 2
    Real.rpow (m : ℝ) (-a) ≤ 2 * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (-a) ∧
      1 / Real.sqrt (m : ℝ) ≤ 2 / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ∧
      2 * Kmean * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (-J) ≤
        2 * Kmean / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

heads.name: eventual_near_window_and_exception_rate
heads.inputProvenance: p>2 and t0>0 from frozen276; ccenter>0 from qualified273 existential
heads.outputUse: All shifted levels <=5/2 are inside centered window and bad relative payment <=2/sqrt(n) uniformly in m>=n/2
heads.headText:
private theorem eventual_near_window_and_exception_rate
    (p t0 ccenter : ℝ) (hp2 : 2 < p)
    (ht0 : 0 < t0) (hccenter : 0 < ccenter) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 8 ≤ N ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
        (3 : ℝ) ≤ ccenter * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((p - 2) / (2 * p)) ∧
          ∀ m : ℕ, n ≤ 2 * m →
            Real.exp (-(t0 / 2) * Real.rpow (m : ℝ) (1 / 3 : ℝ)) ≤
              2 / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

heads.name: near_closed_tail_sandwich_and_rate
heads.purpose: Closed-event perturbation, both sandwiches and relative near error, retaining atoms and exact good-set exception
heads.inputProvenance: Actual P/Tcenter/Tuncenter/Hgood/delta from274 at level2; E/D/Ddelta are fixed original-model constants; hcenter is a LOCAL proved closed-tail certificate from public275 FOURTH plus273, never a public or external CDF assumption
heads.outputUse: Near z in[1,2] part of frozen276, including two newly needed z-level sandwiches
heads.headText:
private theorem near_closed_tail_sandwich_and_rate
    {X : Type u} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (P : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (Tcenter Tuncenter : X → ℝ)
    (hTcenter : Measurable Tcenter) (hTuncenter : Measurable Tuncenter)
    (Hgood : Set X) (hHgood : MeasurableSet Hgood)
    (δ E D Dδ : ℝ)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδhalf : δ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hDδ : 0 ≤ Dδ)
    (hδrate : δ ≤ Dδ * E)
    (hshift : ∀ ξ : X, ξ ∈ Hgood → |Tuncenter ξ - Tcenter ξ| ≤ δ)
    (hbad : P.real Hgoodᶜ / Shao.standardNormalTail 2 ≤ 2 * E)
    (hcenter : ∀ v : ℝ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ v → v ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ) →
      |P.real {ξ : X | v ≤ Tcenter ξ} - Shao.standardNormalTail v| ≤ D * E)
    (z : ℝ) (hz1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ z) (hz2 : z ≤ (2 : ℝ)) :
    P.real {ξ : X | z + δ ≤ Tcenter ξ} - P.real Hgoodᶜ ≤
        P.real {ξ : X | z ≤ Tuncenter ξ} ∧
      P.real {ξ : X | z ≤ Tuncenter ξ} ≤
        P.real {ξ : X | z - δ ≤ Tcenter ξ} + P.real Hgoodᶜ ∧
      |P.real {ξ : X | z ≤ Tuncenter ξ} / Shao.standardNormalTail z - 1| ≤
        ((D + Dδ) / Shao.standardNormalTail 2 + 2) * E

privateH3CenterCertificateMustBeConstruc: PUBLIC275 fourth component at Hstd, actual rho bound from273, finite bridge+273 pointwise Tcenter=Tstd for v<=1; public273 centered tail and Gaussian tail<1 for v>=1
